WYR_MessHallBodyguard_04
Lord Portyr's Bodyguard is a half-elven ranger who accompanies his master to the ceremony of ordaining  Enver Gortash as an Archduke of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

Involvement

Lord Portyr's Bodyguard can be found at the mess hall, at the first floor of the Wyrm's Rock Fortress. He came with his master,  Duke Dillard Portyr, and while waiting for his lord to descend from Audience Hall, spends time with retinue members of other patriars.

If the party speak with him, he reproaches them for their behavior (or maybe outlook), unstately for an official event. He will says that his master might return from the ceremony at any moment.

If the party confront Gortash, Lord Portyr's Bodyguard – along with all other invited guests and their retinue – are subsequently slaughtered in the Audience hall.
